description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Ward], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user. Grants [200% ATB 1] to user, Laguna, and Kiros if Laguna or Kiros is alive.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Water/Ice/Earth abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [111% ATB 1] after using Water/Ice/Earth abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single piercing attack (11.00) capped at 199,999, ranged. Grants [Water, Ice, Earth Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Water, Ice, Earth 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants Deadly Strikes +20% (15s)] to all allies if 4+ Dragoon allies are alive or Kiros or Laguna is alive, grants [Water, Ice, Earth Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)], [Water, Ice, Earth 142% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)] to user if not.

description.name: Water, Ice, Earth Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Water, Ice, or Earth attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Water, Ice, Earth 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)

description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
